## [Optimize the measured hot spot: O(P) piece selection](ROADMAP.md#optimize-the-measured-hot-spot-op-piece-selection) `@templartorrent.milestone.picker-optimization/1`

### Per-rank availability buckets for the live piece picker, oracle-checked

`proposed` · `@templartorrent.work.picker-buckets/1` · part of `@templartorrent.milestone.picker-optimization/1`

Replace the per-call full scan in the live engine's piece selection with an incrementally maintained structure keyed by (piece_rank, availability) so a pick is proportional to candidates in the lowest non-empty rank bucket rather than to the piece count. Keep the scalar Sequence picker unchanged as the oracle, add randomized equivalence tests, extend templartorrent-bench with the new picker beside reference_piece_pick, and gather repeated before/after runs at 1k, 100k and 1M pieces plus a release localhost scenario.
